description.en: Binds a DeepSeek Harness workspace to an SSH host. Adds agent tools for running commands and transferring files over SFTP, a sidebar panel, a server file browser with a directory picker, and a password prompt that appears only when no key or password is configured.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区绑定到一台 SSH 主机：提供执行命令与通过 SFTP 传输文件的 agent 工具、侧栏面板、带目录选择器的服务器文件浏览，以及仅在未配置密钥或密码时出现的密码输入。
